text:
maria_cs: Quick capture from today's Helix call — pulled a few short 'nuggets' that might belong in roadmap scouting.

jon_product: love it, paste the quotes here

maria_cs: Quote from PM: "Our support agents keep seeing users ask for an in-app guided onboarding that walks through model selection + cost estimates per route." They're asking for: 1) onboarding wizard, 2) per-route cost preview, 3) quicker access to small-model variants

alex_se: note: they specifically mentioned latency tradeoffs when switching models, wanted a 'preview' before committing to Dedicated. @jon_product can this map to onboarding flow?

devlin_research: +1 on model-preview card. Also asked about 'embedding freshness' for search use — they want auto-reindex hooks or TTL controls

sara_enablement: flagged for enablement content — can we make a 5-min explainer + short checklist for CSMs to demo the preview and cost estimate?

maria_cs: priority candidate: onboarding wizard (P1 for this customer), embedding TTL controls (P2), per-route cost preview (P1). Customer is in renewal in 60d, mention this in renewal notes.

jon_product: ok will slot onboarding wizard in Q2 backlog scout. embeddings TTL — does this overlap with Optimize? @devlin_research

devlin_research: overlaps but needs product + infra work (hooks + API). Could be a small feature flag experiment first.

alex_se: quick engineering note: KV cache invalidation required for embedding TTL; estimate 2w for a prototype.

feedback-bot: recorded feedback tag: "onboarding_wizard, cost_preview, embedding_ttl" — ticket #CS-98123 created

maria_cs: Thanks — I'll add these to the customer health/renewal doc and loop in AMs. Anyone want to add quick snippets from their side?

jon_product: snippet: "If customers could see token cost before generation and pick a small model fallback for low-cost queries, adoption of per-route routing went up 3x in our pilot." 

sara_enablement: I'll draft a one-pager and share by EOD :thumbsup:

maria_cs: good. tagging @sara_enablement and @jon_product for follow-ups. closing thread for now — will link CS ticket to roadmap scout doc.
